build_streaming_module: build a custom PyTorch streaming module by subclassing StreamingModule and implementing _init_streaming_state and _empty_state
use_streaming_context_manager: use the streaming context manager to process audio chunks incrementally with automatic state reset on exit
create_streaming_conv1d: create a RawStreamingConv1d module to perform streaming 1D convolution on chunked audio tensors
create_streaming_conv_transpose1d: create a RawStreamingConvTranspose1d module to perform streaming 1D transposed convolution on chunked audio tensors
test_streaming_conv_modules: test streaming conv and conv transpose modules by running the built-in test function with various kernel sizes and strides
